EXPIRY ALERTS

Expiry dates
you won't miss.

As dates get close, ShelfTory tells you on the home screen and with notifications. Set when to be alerted for each category, and see past due, today and days left at a glance.

ORGANIZE

Sorted by category
and by where it lives.

Split things into Fridge, Freezer, Pantry and Supplies, then group them by spot — the fridge door, the crisper. Choose a standard, grid or compact view.

FAST INPUT

Less typing,
item by item.

Read items and quantities from a receipt or a shopping-app order screenshot, check them, and add them all at once. Or look up a product name by barcode, or type it in. Photos are read on your device and never sent to our servers.

✓

USE & DISCARD

Swipe right when it's used,
left when you need more.

Swipe an item right to log what you ate, used or threw away; swipe left to add it to your cart. You can log partial amounts too.

✓
Used or eatenQuantity goes down as you use it
✓
DiscardedKept separately so you can see what goes to waste
✓
Add to cartRunning low? One swipe puts it on your list

SHOPPING

Add, check off,
and stock up in one step.

Make shopping lists by store or purpose and check things off as you shop. See what's left and what's expired or expiring while you plan, then move what you bought straight into your items.

WEEKLY MENU

Plan this week's meals
with what you have.

Plan meals by day and mealtime, and note the ingredients and amounts. Tap “Cooked” and the amounts used come off your items; ingredients you don't have can go straight to your cart.
